decisionLog.outcome: Reset 2.2.2 under Andrew Wright, retiring the inherited delivery steps and resource assumptions and redrafting the proposition around partnership infrastructure, access funding, alumni and philanthropy. The proposition is now ready for informal stakeholder sense-check before formal Delivery design.

Rebased the recommended Core planning assumption for partnership infrastructure from £600,000 to £400,000 p.a. from 2027/28, while preserving Year 1 discovery and the requirement to produce lean, Core and more ambitious operating-model options from evidence. Student Opportunities Fund design remains within 2.2.2, but any new award pot is explicitly outside the King's Edge mobilisation ask and requires a separate institutional, consolidated-fund, philanthropic or other funding route.

decisionLog.forum: King's Edge Delivery Plan working update
decisionLog.outcome: Broaden 2.2.2 into Future-Proofed Employability & Experiential Infrastructure. Preserve the existing experiential partnership, access-funding, alumni and philanthropy work; add dedicated international employer-engagement, proactive graduate-transition and incremental global-mobility opportunity-development capability; and set domestic experiential opportunity translation and partnership-infrastructure resource from 2027/28 at the same staffing level as the international employer-engagement team: £214,089 annualised, equivalent on the current fully loaded role-cost basis to 1 x G6 and 3 x G5. Andrew Wright leads the deliverable with Eleanor Hannan as co-lead. The specified staffing package is therefore £664,058 annualised: £214,089 domestic experiential opportunity translation, £214,089 international employer engagement, £126,265 Graduate Transitions and £109,615 Global Mobility opportunity development, alongside a £50,000 international employer-engagement non-pay envelope. The first international G6 and East Asia G5 are targeted for immediate mobilisation, Graduate Transitions from May 2027, and the remaining international, domestic and Global Mobility roles from September 2027. All grade-based staffing figures are to be treated as fully loaded planning costs including employer National Insurance and pension/superannuation, subject to Finance/HR validation before approval. The fully mobilised annualised Core ask for 2.2.2 is £714,058, excluding any separately funded Student Opportunities Fund award pot.
